description: Quoting shippers; posting loads on the load board; checking carrier authority, insurance, and identity; sending rate confirmations; dispatching the carrier
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 4 to 5 truckloads and $720 of margin per business day; shippers send loads to another broker after a missed day; rate confirmations also sit in sent email, so a 24-hour RPO can be rebuilt
manual_workaround: Take shipper tenders by phone; book only carriers already in the carrier file; send rate confirmations from the phone's email app; enter loads in the TMS after recovery
dependent_third_parties: TMS vendor; load board and carrier monitoring providers; email provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); home office

description: Tracking 6 to 10 loads in transit; check calls and texts with drivers; appointment changes; delivery problems, damage, and shortages; status updates to shippers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loads move around the clock; a missed appointment or an unanswered driver call costs the shipper relationship within one shift; a fictitious pickup or cargo theft is caught only by watching loads in transit; TMS vendor RPO of 24 hours does not meet the 4-hour RPO, so a twice-daily in-transit list is the compensating copy
manual_workaround: Printed or downloaded in-transit list (driver, phone, appointment, consignee) twice a day; calls and texts from the phone; tracking app status by its own web page
dependent_third_parties: TMS vendor; tracking app provider; mobile and VoIP carriers; motor carriers and drivers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; only person drivers and shippers can reach)

description: Placing car orders, entering shipping instructions, tracing cars, and watching demurrage in the railroads' customer portals for 4 shippers; booking transload truck legs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Railroads plan car supply and pull loaded cars daily; a loaded car without shipping instructions is not moved and demurrage accrues to the shipper; the portals hold the data, so RPO is the owner's own notes
manual_workaround: Ask the shipper's own traffic staff to enter shipping instructions in the portal; call the railroad's customer service center for car orders and tracing
dependent_third_parties: Railroads (two Class I and one short line); transload operators; shippers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure for 3 shippers' portal user IDs)

description: Shipper invoices after POD; carrier payables on 30-day terms by ACH; carrier bank details; collections; 1099 data
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $26,000 of truckload freight billed per week; carriers paid late complain on load boards and can claim against the $75,000 surety bond, which the owner must answer within 7 business days (49 CFR 387.307(e)(1)(ii))
manual_workaround: Hold the weekly ACH batch; pay only from bank details confirmed by call-back; invoice from the TMS on the phone or by email; personal savings cover about one month of carrier payables float
dependent_third_parties: TMS vendor; accounting SaaS provider; business bank; surety company

description: FMCSA registration record and account; surety bond and BOC-3; UCR; carrier onboarding packets; insurance certificates; 3-year transaction records (49 CFR 371.3(b)); FMCSA, surety, and process agent mail and email
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A surety claim or an FMCSA suspension notice must be answered within 7 business days (387.307(e)(5)-(6)); losing broker authority stops BP-01 entirely; registration changes are due within 30 days (49 U.S.C. 13904(g))
manual_workaround: Check the paper mail and the FMCSA record daily during an outage; the transportation attorney can respond to a surety or FMCSA notice with the owner's written authorization
dependent_third_parties: FMCSA; surety company; blanket process agent company; insurance agent
